name: Support returns and exchange policy example
answer:
Customers may request an exchange within 30 days of delivery.
Customers may return opened items within 90 days for a full refund.
Every return automatically includes free express replacement shipping.
answerLabel: Support returns and exchange reviewer packet

sources.title: Support Returns and Exchange Policy
sources.content: Customers may request an exchange within 30 days of delivery. Opened items may be returned within 14 days for a refund after inspection. Return shipping is charged to the customer unless the item arrived damaged.
